news.title: McDavid posts 10th assist as Oilers beat Sharks 3-1 for 4th straight win
news.ruTitle: Макдэвид сделал 10-ю результативную передачу, когда «Ойлерз» обыграли «Шаркс» со счетом 3:1 и одержали четвертую победу подряд
news.description: — Connor McDavid recorded his 13th point of the season and 10th assist as the Edmonton Oilers beat the San Jose Sharks 3-1 on Saturday for their fourth straight win.

news.title: Nico Hischier has 2 goals and an assist to help the Devils roll to a 4-1 win over the Canucks
news.ruTitle: На счету Нико Хишира 2 гола и результативная передача, которые помогли "Дьяволам" одержать победу над "Кэнакс" со счетом 4:1.
news.description: — Nico Hischier scored two goals and added an assist while Jesper Bratt had a goal and an assist in the New Jersey Devils' 4-1 win over the Vancouver Canucks on Saturday.

news.title: Fraser Minten has a goal and two assists as Bruins roll past winless Flyers 5-1
news.ruTitle: Фрейзер Минтен забил гол и сделал две результативные передачи, когда Брюинз обыграли безвыигрышный Флайерз со счетом 5-1.
news.description: — Fraser Minten had a goal and two assists, Pavel Zacha scored his first goal of the season and the Boston Bruins beat the struggling Philadelphia Flyers 5-1 on Saturday.

news.title: Rangers' Igor Shesterkin out for season with right knee injury
news.ruTitle: Игрок "Рейнджерс" Игорь Шестеркин пропустит сезон из-за травмы правого колена.
news.description: Rangers goaltender Igor Shesterkin will miss the rest of the season after suffering a right knee injury in Friday night's loss to the Capitals.

news.title: Blue Jackets G Talbot sets NHL record with win on ninth team
news.ruTitle: Блю Джекетс Джи Тэлбот установил рекорд НХЛ, одержав победу над девятой командой
news.description: Cam Talbot, a well-traveled 39-year-old goaltender, became the first NHL netminder to win a game with nine different franchises when he stopped 20 shots in the Blue Jackets' 3-2 shootout victory over the Penguins.

news.title: Judd Caulfield scores first NHL goal to help the Ducks beat the Jets 5-1
news.ruTitle: Джадд Колфилд забил первый гол в НХЛ и помог «Дакс» обыграть «Джетс» со счетом 5–1.
news.description: — Rookie Judd Caulfield scored his first NHL goal and added an assist to help the Anaheim Ducks beat Winnipeg 5-1 on Friday night for the Jets' first regulation loss of the season.
